title: Embody the score32 exact aligned transport codec
hypothesis: A field-preserving two-flit codec can sustain the 256-bit NoC payload cadence with small PPA relative to the exact reducer and mesh.

direct_comparison.primary_question: What PPA and cadence are required to transport one exact 419-bit aggregate beat without precision loss?
include: compact deterministic source and folded sink harness

expected_benefit: remove exact aggregate field preservation from the Phase-2 abstraction list
establish a direct PPA baseline for packed and stats-once codecs
prove continuous one-flit-per-cycle transport under backpressure
risks: the retained 419-bit registers may dominate this small block
compact harness support logic is included in measured PPA
standalone PPA does not predict composed endpoint or routing timing

required_evaluations.objective: Measure Nangate45 PPA for the exact 419-bit aggregate aligned two-flit codec.
